test_title: PYST 56: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question:
Study the given bar graph and answer the question that follows.

The bar-graph given below shows the average marks scored by six students (A, B, C, D, E and F) in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry. The maximum marks of each subject is 100.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b500a58cc14c6d1c54eadbcd68d48cd176765d4c4283c7174a1602d725ae78c9.png] 

Find the difference between the total marks scored by B in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry to the total marks scored by F in Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.
solution:
Calculations:

Total marks scored by Student B:

Mathematics: 80

Physics: 85

Chemistry: 90

Total marks for B = 80 + 85 + 90 = 255

Total marks scored by Student F:

Mathematics: 92

Physics: 88

Chemistry: 96

Total marks for F = 92 + 88 + 96 = 276

Find the difference between their total marks:

Difference = Total marks of F - Total marks of B

Difference = 276 - 255 = 21

The difference between the total marks scored by B and F is 21.
